cases.historical_claim: Every workflow session should be excluded from the index.
cases.corrected_claim: Exclusion is scoped to brain-worker subagents and session-miner or weave agents; it is not all workflows.
cases.expected_digest: workflow session indexing · default visibility: replace 'exclude every workflow' with 'exclude brain-worker, session-miner, and weave agents only' (AGENTS.md:145)

cases.historical_claim: A worktree branch name may be stored as project.
cases.corrected_claim: Project is always the canonical repository; branch is a separate field.
cases.expected_digest: chunk provenance · project identity: replace 'project may equal branch' with 'project is the repository and branch is separate' (AGENTS.md:243)

cases.historical_claim: A visible brainlayer worker pane can stand in for an ingest-excluded brain-worker.
cases.corrected_claim: A brain-worker is an ingest-excluded subagent class; a visible brainlayer worker ingests normally.
cases.expected_digest: brain-worker · source class: replace 'visible BrainLayer pane' with 'ingest-excluded subagent class' (AGENTS.md:151)

cases.source_excerpt: UPDATE it, don't store again beside it
cases.historical_claim: When a stored memory is wrong, store the correction beside it.
cases.corrected_claim: When a stored memory is wrong, update it instead of storing a duplicate beside it.
cases.expected_digest: stored correction · replacement behavior: replace 'store beside the old memory' with 'update the wrong memory' (AGENTS.md:25)

cases.historical_claim: A merged BrainLayer change is deployed.
cases.corrected_claim: Merged is not deployed; verify the artifact that executes.
cases.expected_digest: merged change · deployment state: replace 'merged means deployed' with 'verify the executing artifact' (AGENTS.md:35)

cases.source_excerpt: Pre-merge live-check against a DB copy

cases.corrected_claim: Every pre-merge live check for a stored-data change runs against a database copy.
cases.expected_digest: stored-data change · pre-merge test target: replace 'test against production' with 'test against a database copy' (AGENTS.md:249)

cases.corrected_claim: Transcripts move to archive only after embedding and reader-parity checks.
